root_cause.invariant: Session must make bounded forward progress sending a valid 16KiB application chunk over a peer receive window that has remaining credit smaller than the first encoded wire fragment, without replay.
mechanism: Session.send_data/5 accepts up to 16384 bytes, encodes an HTTP/3 DATA frame and chunks that encoded frame using fixed session.max_frame=16384 (session.ex:131-135,615-626). The first transport send for this input is 16384 wire bytes; encoding adds a suffix beyond that.

Request HEADERS already consumed nonzero credit on the request stream. Fixture aioquic initial max_stream_data is 16384 (origin.py:118). Remaining credit is therefore less than the first fixed 16384-byte transport send.

Quic.Streams.send/4 admits the whole binary atomically; send_credit rejects if send_offset + bytes > send_limit or aggregate connection credit is exceeded (streams.ex:215-246,557-562). data_blocked value93 is aggregate data_sent, not exact request-stream offset.

HandshakeScheduler.send_stream returns blocked without adding a prefix to the bounded send queue; Connection.execute_operation records rejection and returns with unchanged scheduler/no send effects (handshake_scheduler.ex:146-185, connection.ex:1263-1280).

aioquic raises stream credit when highest received offset exceeds half its current limit (connection.py:3573-3600). Small request HEADERS alone do not cross the 8192-byte threshold. Since no DATA prefix is sent, the receiver cannot trigger that growth.

Session.resume/1 reruns the same pending send; suspend_blocked/resume/2 preserve the same original work and deadline, not an adaptive smaller fragment (session.ex:171-207,293-307). 822 retries show the frozen admission deadlock persisting to deadline.

Authenticated MAX_DATA/MAX_STREAM_DATA are processed in the QUIC network dispatch independently of Session.poll (handshake_scheduler.ex:1567-1577). Polling response/control cannot manufacture missing outbound credit or split the pending send.
root_cause.public_api_analysis: Session exposes new(max_frame: ...) but no public pending-rechunk/send-credit operation. Public Quic.info metadata reports receive/resources/highwaters, not an adaptive Session send window; extracting Session transport handles or mutating continuation internals is outside the supported boundary.
root_cause.smaller_input_limit: The approved 16KiB maximum permits smaller application input, but replacing this required chunk with a smaller fixed input/frame size merely avoids this particular credit boundary. Fixed fragments may still exceed a peer's residual stream/connection credit; this would not establish general progress of the selected default Session contract. Changing the frozen max_frame or peer window to pass the fixture is not authorized and was not attempted.
root_cause.confidence: Mechanism supported by immutable actual network failure plus installed dependency and peer source. No new live or boundary-double reproduction was run in this assignment.
